newsitem.title: SPAIN: Santander Q3 financial earnings fall vs Q2.
newsitem.headline: Santander Q3 financial earnings fall vs Q2.

text.p: Spain's Banco Santander nine-month results show a fall in profit from financial operations in the third quarter versus the second quarter, although the profit rose from the first quarter, the bank said.
The year-on-year trend showed an around 49 percent increase in profit.

Earnings from financial operations were 52.26 billion pesetas in the nine months to September, and in the third quarter alone 15.52 billion pesetas compared with 23.97 in the second quarter and 12.76 billion in the first quarter.

In its quarterly report, Santander attributed the 9.4 percent year-on-year increase in net interest income in the third quarter to loan growth in Spain, particularly in mortgages and consumer loans. This growth offset the effect of lower interest rates on the deposit side.

Third quarter loan loss provisions stood at 13.09 billion pesetas. The provisions include 1.54 billion pesetas in country risk provisions, 5.25 billion loan loss provisions at Banesto, and 5.8 billion pesetas relating to Santander's overseas operations, the bank said.
